newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa to cut costs, diversify assets.
newsitem.headline: Endesa to cut costs, diversify assets.

text.p: Spain's Endesa said on Friday it would launch a plan to cut costs and to diversify its assets.
In a statement following a presentation to analysts, Endesa said it had launched a drive to cut its overall costs by 2001 from those of 1996, which were about 82 billion pesetas.
In addition, Endesa said it would cut 225 billion pesetas in recurring operating investments in basic business in this period.

It also said it would boost the diversity of its business. "In the next five years, Endesa expects its activities in International and Diversification to reach 20 percent of its assets, compared with the current six percent," the statement said.
